title: Saved Teleport Enhanced Keyless
features:
Final version 

Features
1: Create unlimited custom waypoints anywhere in any game
2: One-click teleport to any saved waypoint
3: Waypoints auto-save instantly when created or deleted
4: Persistent storage – waypoints reload automatically after rejoining
5: Clean, modern, draggable GUI with the Toggle button draggable aswell 
6: Separate toggle button to show/hide the waypoint menu
7: Easily delete waypoints at any time
8: Supports multiple games (waypoints are saved per game)

Different have game different waypoints if you set for example in game 1 you set 3 different waypoints then whenever you leave and join any game except game 1 your waypoints won't won't show up because you're not in game 1, next time again when u join game 1 you will see those exact 3 waypoints you made, this works for all the games. Y'all should've understood how it works y'all aren't kids.
